<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Enable certified canonical KV offloading for `ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec` using the existing mapping and scheduler paths. Implements my [claimed cache-type slice](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/61886#issuecomment-6217606040) of #61886.

**Depends on #62160.** This branch includes that prerequisite; merge the storage fix first. [Feature-only diff](https://github.com/xiaoba17/vllm/compare/a99a46153a3b13034339b32942773b44d0cb651d...3172b52d123acf1bea4f78313089d58354e9ac3a).

## Claims

- Compatible chunked-local and mixed chunked-local/full-attention caches pass the static canonical portability gate.
- Unsupported head configurations, quantization and parallel layouts remain rejected.
- Targeted tests cover cross-TP byte reconstruction, tensor strides/offsets and chunk-boundary store/load behavior.

## Validation

Final tested commit: `3172b52d12`.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_config.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_canonical_mapping.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/test_file_mapper.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_worker.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_scheduler.py \
  tests/v1/kv_offload/test_factory.py
```

**702 passed, 2 skipped** on Linux. These totals include existing regressions, not only new cases. Pre-commit passed. Mapping tests exercise TP1/TP2/TP4; real GPU tests use TP1/TP2.

**2× RTX 5090**, deterministic tiny Llama4 (3 chunked-local layers + 1 full-attention layer), FP16/eager/Triton, chunk size 128 and block size 16: **10 inference processes passed**, covering independent filesystem producer/read pairs, six pressure cycles and a fresh TP1 read after pressure.

| KV heads | Direction | Cold/reload cache-hit contexts | Max absolute logprob delta |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 (replicated at TP2) | TP1 → TP2 | 240/240 in each phase | 0.001486 |
| 1 | TP2 → TP1 | 240/240 in each phase | 0.003836 |
| 2 (sharded at TP2) | TP1 → TP2 | 240/240 in each phase | 0.001499 |
| 2 | TP2 → TP1 | 240/240 in each phase | 0.001481 |

Compare all 512 vocabulary logprobs at 240 fixed teacher-forced contexts with offload-disabled TP1 references; tolerance 0.005. Prompt lengths straddle 64/128/256/384/512 boundaries. Nonzero filesystem reads and increasing CPU→GPU counters confirm reuse rather than recomputation. Pressure validation constrains the CPU cache to 512 KiB; misses/skipped stores are expected there. The subsequent fresh TP1 reader hits 240/240 contexts in both phases.

[Commands, CPU logs, numerical/transfer results, environment and source hashes](https://github.com/xiaoba17/vllm/tree/10218a6806b5fff79919eb02fff11c265d2c41de). The custom dual-GPU harness was run outside CI and is archived with its original host paths; no new GPU CI job is claimed. Unit tests extend suites already covered by Buildkite.

## Details

Only the static certification gate needs production changes beyond #62160: runtime canonical mapping already operates on attention tensors and the scheduler already handles chunked-local windows. Tests verify these paths rather than introducing another mapping or scheduler implementation.

Usage: set `canonical_layout: true` in `OffloadingConnector`'s `kv_connector_extra_config` on every sharing instance. For filesystem reuse use `spec_name: "TieringOffloadingSpec"`, a CPU budget and a shared FS secondary tier as in the archived harness. This extends the supported cache types for that existing option; the canonical-layout usage documentation is being added in #61822, so this PR does not duplicate its guide.

Duplicate-work check: no open PR implements this chunked-local gate extension. #61822 is documentation, #51691 is quantization, and #60782 is a shared-region refactor. Recurrent/Mamba and general filesystem/object-store test infrastructure claimed by others in #61886 remain outside this change.

Limits: random tiny weights establish execution/cache correctness, not trained-model quality or throughput. The sharded model has one near-tied argmax change among 240 contexts in each direction; tolerance passes, but tokenwise/bitwise equality is not claimed. No TP4 GPU, CUDA Graph or multi-node validation. GPU/native extensions use baseline `8e25bbca19`; latest-main mergeability was checked separately.

AI assistance: Codex assisted with implementation, validation, and PR preparation. I have reviewed the changes and completed the relevant tests and behavioral validation.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("form", sorted(CACHE_BUILDERS))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "writer_tp,reader_tp", [(1, 2), (2, 1), (1, 4), (4, 1), (2, 4), (4, 2)]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("total_heads", [2, 8])
+def test_chunked_local_cross_tp_store_load(form, writer_tp, reader_tp, total_heads):
+    """Real derived mappings reconstruct independent KV shards, including replicas."""
+    full_kv = torch.randint(
+        -128,
+        128,
+        (NUM_BLOCKS, 2, 4, total_heads, 64),
+        dtype=torch.int8,
+        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(0),
+    )
+
+    def physical_pages(kv):
+        # Encode logical [block, K/V, token, head, channel] without copy runs.
+        if form.startswith("packed"):
+            kv = torch.cat((kv[:, 0], kv[:, 1]), dim=-1)
+            if form.endswith("hnd"):
+                kv = kv.permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
+        elif form.endswith("hnd"):
+            kv = kv.permute(0, 1, 3, 2, 4)
+        return [page.contiguous().numpy().tobytes() for page in kv]
+
+    def shards_at(tp):
+        heads = max(1, total_heads // tp)
+        replicas = max(1, tp // total_heads)
+        spec = ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=4,
+            num_kv_heads=heads,
+            head_size=64,
+            dtype=torch.int8,
+            attention_chunk_size=8,
+        )
+        config = _vllm_config(tp=tp, total_kv_heads=total_heads)
+        kv_config = _kv_cache_config([KVCacheGroupSpec(["local"], spec)])
+        mappings, pages = [], []
+        for rank in range(tp):
+            config.parallel_config.rank = rank
+            mapping = derive_canonical_mappings(
+                config, kv_config, {"local": CACHE_BUILDERS[form](spec)}
+            )["local"]
+            assert mapping.parallelism_agnostic
+            mappings.append(mapping)
+            first_head = rank // replicas * heads
+            pages.append(
+                physical_pages(full_kv[:, :, :, first_head : first_head + heads])
+            )
+        return mappings, pages
+
+    writers, writer_pages = shards_at(writer_tp)
+    readers, reader_pages = shards_at(reader_tp)
+    for block_id, expected in enumerate(physical_pages(full_kv)):
+        stored = _store_all(
+            writers,
+            [pages[block_id] for pages in writer_pages],
+            len(expected),
+            block_id,
+        )
+        assert stored == expected
+        for mapping, pages in zip(readers, reader_pages):
+            assert _load_one(mapping, stored) == pages[block_id]
+
+
 def test_cp_round_trip():
     # tp=4 / dcp=2 / 2 KV heads: 4 workers jointly hold one canonical page
     spec = _full_spec(num_kv_heads=1)

+        attention_chunk_size=8,
+    )
+    config = _make_vllm_config(extra_config={"canonical_layout": True})
+    config.cache_config.block_size = 4
+    config.model_config.get_total_num_kv_heads.return_value = 1
+    config.speculative_config = None
+    kv_config = KVCacheConfig(
+        num_blocks=32,
+        kv_cache_tensors=[],
+        kv_cache_groups=[KVCacheGroupSpec(["local"], cache_spec)],
+    )
+    spec = MockOffloadingSpec(build_offloading_config(config, kv_config))
+    assert spec.config.parallel.is_parallelism_agnostic
+    scheduler = OffloadingConnectorScheduler(spec, config, kv_config)
+    request = MagicMock()
+    request.request_id = "local"
+    request.kv_transfer_params = None
+    request.num_tokens = request.num_prompt_tokens = prompt_tokens
+    request.num_computed_tokens = 0
+    request.block_hashes = [
+        BlockHash(f"h{i}".encode()) for i in range(prompt_tokens // 4)
+    ]
+    request.is_finished.return_value = False
+    request.skip_reading_prefix_cache = False
+    request.status = RequestStatus.RUNNING
+    scheduler.on_new_request(request)
+    manager = ChunkedLocalAttentionManager(
+        kv_cache_spec=cache_spec,
+        block_pool=BlockPool(32, enable_caching=True, hash_block_size=4),
+        enable_caching=True,
+        kv_cache_group_id=0,
+        scheduler_block_size=4,
+    )
+    return scheduler, request, manager
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("prompt_tokens", [7, 8, 9, 31, 32, 33])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("step_size", [4, 32])
+def test_chunked_local_prefill_store_boundaries(prompt_tokens, step_size):
+    """Prefill stores complete live blocks once, never released or partial blocks."""
+    scheduler, request, manager = _make_chunked_local_scheduler(prompt_tokens)
+    state = scheduler._req_status[request.request_id]
+    state.update_offload_keys()
+    blocks = manager.block_pool.get_new_blocks((prompt_tokens + 3) // 4)
+    manager.req_to_blocks[request.request_id] = blocks
+    scheduler.manager.prepare_store.side_effect = (
+        lambda keys, ctx: generate_store_output(keys)
+    )
+    stored: set[int] = set()
+    for start in range(0, prompt_tokens, step_size):
+        end = min(start + step_size, prompt_tokens)
+        request.num_computed_tokens = start
+        manager.remove_skipped_blocks(request.request_id, start)
+        state.group_states[0].block_ids[:] = [b.block_id for b in blocks]
+        output = SchedulerOutput.make_empty()
+        output.num_scheduled_tokens = {request.request_id: end - start}
+        jobs = scheduler._build_store_jobs(output)
+        expected_indices = set(range(start // 8 * 2, end // 4)) - stored
+        actual_keys = {key for jid in jobs for key in scheduler._jobs[jid].keys}
+        assert actual_keys == {
+            make_offload_key(request.block_hashes[i], 0) for i in expected_indices
+        }
+        assert [bid for job in jobs.values() for bid in job.src_spec.block_ids] == [
+            blocks[i].block_id for i in sorted(expected_indices)
+        ]
+        stored.update(expected_indices)
+        scheduler.update_connector_output(
+            KVConnectorOutput(
+                kv_connector_worker_meta=OffloadingWorkerMetadata(
+                    completed_jobs={jid: 1 for jid in jobs}
+                )
+            )
+        )
+    assert stored == set(range(prompt_tokens // 4))
+
+
+def test_chunked_local_store_retry_skips_released_blocks():
+    """A failed store must not retry keys whose GPU blocks have since been freed."""
+    scheduler, request, manager = _make_chunked_local_scheduler(13)
+    state = scheduler._req_status[request.request_id]
+    state.update_offload_keys()
+    blocks = manager.block_pool.get_new_blocks(4)
+    manager.req_to_blocks[request.request_id] = blocks
+    state.group_states[0].block_ids[:] = [b.block_id for b in blocks]
+    output = SchedulerOutput.make_empty()
+    output.num_scheduled_tokens = {request.request_id: 8}
+    scheduler.manager.prepare_store.return_value = None
+    assert not scheduler._build_store_jobs(output)
+    assert state.group_states[0].next_stored_chunk_idx == 0
+
+    request.num_computed_tokens = 8
+    manager.remove_skipped_blocks(request.request_id, 8)
+    assert all(b.is_null for b in blocks[:2])
+    state.group_states[0].block_ids[:] = [b.block_id for b in blocks]
+    output.num_scheduled_tokens = {request.request_id: 4}
+    scheduler.manager.prepare_store.side_effect = (
+        lambda keys, ctx: generate_store_output(keys)
+    )
+    jobs = scheduler._build_store_jobs(output)
+    [job_id] = jobs
+    assert scheduler._jobs[job_id].keys == {
+        make_offload_key(request.block_hashes[2], 0)
+    }
+    assert jobs[job_id].src_spec.block_ids.tolist() == [blocks[2].block_id]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("prompt_tokens", [7, 8, 9, 31, 32, 33])
+def test_chunked_local_load_skips_previous_attention_chunks(prompt_tokens):
+    """Load jobs restore only the live chunk, including an empty tail at its start."""
+    scheduler, request, manager = _make_chunked_local_scheduler(prompt_tokens)
+    scheduler.manager.lookup.return_value = LookupResult.HIT
+    external, asynchronous = scheduler.get_num_new_matched_tokens(request, 0)
+    # A cached full block may supply all but the final prompt token.
+    boundary = min(prompt_tokens // 4 * 4, prompt_tokens - 1)
+    assert (external, asynchronous) == (boundary, True)
+    manager.add_local_computed_blocks(request.request_id, [], 0, boundary)
+    manager.allocate_external_computed_blocks(request.request_id, 0, boundary)
+    blocks = manager.req_to_blocks[request.request_id]
+    scheduler.update_state_after_alloc(request, KVCacheBlocks((blocks,)), boundary)
+    [job] = scheduler._current_batch_load_jobs.values()
+    first_live = boundary // 8 * 2
+    assert job.src_spec.offload_keys == [
+        make_offload_key(request.block_hashes[i], 0)
+        for i in range(first_live, (boundary + 3) // 4)
+    ]
+    assert job.dst_spec.block_ids.tolist() == [
+        block.block_id for block in blocks[first_live : (boundary + 3) // 4]
+    ]
+    assert all(block.is_null for block in blocks[:first_live])
+
+
